description: This file defines the 'DB' class within the 'Opencart\System\Library\Session' namespace. The class manages session data persistence, providing methods to read, write, destroy, and perform garbage collection on session data stored in a database table named 'session'.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: Handles database-backed session management including reading, writing, deleting, and cleaning up expired sessions.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the DB class with references to the database connection and configuration objects.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Fetches and decodes session data from the database for a given session ID.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Stores or updates session data in the database for a given session ID.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Deletes session data associated with the specified session ID from the database.

methods.name: gc
methods.description: Performs garbage collection by deleting expired sessions based on a probabilistic approach.
